versions.changelog: Add checkpoint trap: validate checkpoints with guard-5 assertions on resume; a corrupt checkpoint defends the wrong output

Structural fixes per scanner findings: two-stage rule accumulation (same-turn capture into ERROR-PLAYBOOK.staging.md; promotion to the authoritative playbook only on recurrence or human confirmation), pinned the playbook download URL to a reviewed commit, narrowed trigger keywords.

Add a companion-file section to both READMEs pointing at the public error-playbook mirror, so a fresh clone knows what guard #7 writes to and where to fetch it. Also removes three leftover contradictions with Hard Rule #7 (operating step 5, human-in-the-loop list, failure-handling row, output-format line, reference pattern) that still said new rules wait for human approval.

Guard #7 reversed: the agent appends confirmed failures to the error playbook in the same turn, human review is rollback not approval, so unattended runs still accumulate rules. Added operation-to-section query map for the knowledge base, unattended-run gate section, and Chinese colloquial trigger keywords.
Align name with slug; expand retrieval keywords (EN+ZH), read_when triggers, and tags to widen entry points
Add not_for field (agent routing exclusion) per skill-design-guide Principle Two: agent-consumption-first design
Add Chinese summary with trigger keywords to description

Re-release under unambiguous slug (previous 'workflow-guardian' slug collided with another publisher, leaving a broken CLI record); seven guards: pre-check, checkpoint, side-effect queue, retry budget, result validation, audit log, rule accumulation
